simple.meaning: חָמַשׁ (châmash) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to tax a fifth.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Genesis, beginning at Genesis 41:34. The surrounding contexts include land, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חָמַשׁ (H2567) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: חָמַשׁ (châmash) / H2567 is traced through Genesis 41:34 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H2567. chamash II. [ חמשׁ ] verb denominative only Pi`el מִצְרַיִם אֶרֶץ אֶתֿ וְחִמֵּשׁ Gen 41:34 (E) and he shall fifth (take the fifth part of) the land of Egypt , i.e. the fifth part of the produce (compare Arabic take a fifth part ; Ethiopic 1. 2 quinque facere ).

occurrences.englishText: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint overseers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt’s produce in the seven plenteous years.
